attribute_fields.COMMENTS: RhodeIsland state income tax (2025). Simplified top-marginal-rate implementation per R.I. Gen. Laws § 44-30-2.6: tax = max(AGI - filing-status std ded, 0) x 5.99%. Standard deductions: $10,550 Single/MFS, $21,150 MFJ/QSS, $15,850 HOH. Real brackets are a follow-up. Writes result.computed_state_tax and result.computed_state_taxable_income.

initial_action.initial_action_dsl: set result.computed_state_tax = 0; set result.computed_state_taxable_income = 0; add " Rhode Island Tax Calculation (top marginal 5.99%)" to job.audit_trail
initial_action.initial_action_postfix: 0 cvd /result.computed_state_tax xdef 0 cvd /result.computed_state_taxable_income xdef " Rhode Island Tax Calculation (top marginal 5.99%)" job.audit_trail swap addto

condition_details.condition_comment: Filing status is Married Filing Jointly or Qualifying Surviving Spouse
condition_details.condition_dsl: job.filing_status is equal to "MFJ" or job.filing_status is equal to "QSS"
condition_details.condition_postfix: job.filing_status "MFJ" streq { pop job.filing_status "QSS" streq } over not if

condition_details.condition_comment: Filing status is Head of Household

action_details.action_dsl: set result.computed_state_taxable_income = the maximum of (result.agi - 21150.0) and 0.0; set result.computed_state_tax = result.computed_state_taxable_income * 0.0599
action_details.action_postfix: result.agi 21150.0 f- 0.0 fmax cvd /result.computed_state_taxable_income xdef result.computed_state_taxable_income 0.0599 fmul cvd /result.computed_state_tax xdef

action_details.action_dsl: set result.computed_state_taxable_income = the maximum of (result.agi - 15850.0) and 0.0; set result.computed_state_tax = result.computed_state_taxable_income * 0.0599
action_details.action_postfix: result.agi 15850.0 f- 0.0 fmax cvd /result.computed_state_taxable_income xdef result.computed_state_taxable_income 0.0599 fmul cvd /result.computed_state_tax xdef

action_details.action_postfix: result.agi 10550.0 f- 0.0 fmax cvd /result.computed_state_taxable_income xdef result.computed_state_taxable_income 0.0599 fmul cvd /result.computed_state_tax xdef
